global_limits: Account wide: up to 10000 API calls per minute (error 40202) and at most 30 simultaneous requests (error 40209), per docs.dataforseo.com/v3/appendix/errors.

mode_legend.live: one POST returns results immediately; one task per call
mode_legend.task_post: Standard method step 1: queue up to 100 tasks per call; this is where the task is billed (Standard or Priority queue)
mode_legend.task_get: Standard method step 3: fetch a queued task result by id; not billed separately
mode_legend.tasks_ready: Standard method step 2: list completed, uncollected task ids; free; usually 20 calls per minute
mode_legend.standard: reference or account endpoints (locations, languages, categories, filters, models, id_list, errors, status, user_data); mostly free
mode_legend.other: see mode_detail: tasks_fixed (re-parsed SERP tasks) or task_result (OnPage crawl results read after task_post)

price_note: usd is the per-call or per-unit base for the default tier (Live for live, Standard queue for task_post). For two-part prices (task + row/item) usd is the task part; the row/item part is in note and tiers. Extra-charge parameters (for example calculate_rectangles, load_async_ai_overview, search operators x5) are in each docs page, not here.
